title: Classified Navy diver unit experimenting with liquid breathing
summary: Tim Gallaudet tells of Classified Navy diver unit experimenting with liquid breathing, about unspecified at Undisclosed, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There is a There is a a a special unit, I'm not going to say exactly where, of Navy divers that have experimented with that technology.

plain: Tim Gallaudet, a retired US Navy admiral, says there is a special unit of Navy divers, whose location he won't name, that has experimented with liquid breathing, where a person breathes an oxygen-rich liquid instead of air. He tells it while talking about what lies hidden in the ocean, and if true it would mean the Navy is quietly testing technology most people think of as science fiction.
